name: supaschema

scripts.bench:plot:docs: node benchmarks/plot.js benchmarks/results/comparison.json benchmarks/results/comparison-realistic.json benchmarks/results/comparison-xl.json benchmarks/results/comparison-xxl.json --charts-dir docs/images/benchmarks && npm run bench:plot:headtohead
scripts.bench:plot:headtohead: node benchmarks/plot-head-to-head.js --bars-only benchmarks/results/comparison-xl.json docs/images/benchmarks/head-to-head-xl-bars.svg && node benchmarks/plot-head-to-head.js benchmarks/results/comparison-xl.json docs/images/benchmarks/head-to-head-xl.svg && node benchmarks/plot-head-to-head.js benchmarks/results/comparison-xxl.json docs/images/benchmarks/head-to-head-xxl.svg && node benchmarks/plot-head-to-head.js --workflow benchmarks/results/comparison-xl.json docs/images/benchmarks/head-to-head-workflow-xl.svg && npm run format -- docs/images/benchmarks
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -b tsconfig.src.json --force && node dist/config/schema-gen.js && node scripts/ensure-bin-executable.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.corpus:check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js corpus --corpus-dir corpus/supabase-style
scripts.diagrams: node benchmarks/plot-concepts.js && npm run format -- docs/images/concepts
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:lint && cd docs && npx --yes mint@4.2.616 validate && npx --yes mint@4.2.616 broken-links --check-anchors && npx --yes mint@4.2.616 a11y
scripts.fastmcp:inspect: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp fastmcp inspect fastmcp.json
scripts.fastmcp:status: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp fastmcp call services/agent-mcp/supaschema_agent_mcp/server.py server_status --json
scripts.fixture:diff: node dist/cli.js --config tests/fixtures/basic/supaschema.config.json diff --from dir:tests/fixtures/basic/from --to dir:tests/fixtures/basic/to --out stdout
scripts.fixture:verify: npm run build && out=$(mktemp -d)/basic.sql && node dist/cli.js --config tests/fixtures/basic/supaschema.config.json diff --from dir:tests/fixtures/basic/from --to dir:tests/fixtures/basic/to --out "$out" && node dist/cli.js --config tests/fixtures/basic/supaschema.config.json verify --from dir:tests/fixtures/basic/from --to dir:tests/fixtures/basic/to --migration "$out"
scripts.py:fix: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp ruff check --fix services/agent-mcp && uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp ruff format services/agent-mcp
scripts.py:format:check: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp ruff format --check services/agent-mcp
scripts.py:lint: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp ruff check services/agent-mcp
scripts.release:verify: npm run guard:release-version && npm test -- tests/release/action.test.ts tests/release/preflight.test.ts && npm run build && npm run check:package && npm run test:consumer-lifecycle && npm run package:smoke && npm run pack:dry && npm run guard

description: Declarative PostgreSQL schema management: fast, AI-ready, and zero-config, with replay-safe migrations and generated TypeScript and Zod.
author: John McLaughlin
